name: Safari
note: Safari's File and View menus carry a few shortcuts the cited page does not list; those are marked in 'from'.

newTab.from: Safari File menu: New Tab; not on the cited page

newWindow.from: Safari File menu: New Window; not on the cited page

closeWindow.from: Safari File menu: Close Window; not on the cited page

quit.from: macOS convention; the cited page does not list it

reload.from: Safari View menu: Reload Page; not on the cited page

previousTab.from: Go to previous tab (Shift-Command-[; also Control-Shift-Tab)

nextTab.from: Go to next tab (Shift-Command-]; also Control-Tab)

unbound.focusTabList: Safari has no command to move the focus to a tab list.
unbound.moveTabUp: Safari has no command to move a tab.
unbound.moveTabDown: Safari has no command to move a tab.
